def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    order_items = db['order_items']
    orders = db['orders']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_list = list(entity_ids)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_list)

    feature_names = [
        'n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
        'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
        'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
        'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews',
        'n_orders_last_30', 'n_orders_last_60', 'n_orders_last_90',
        'n_orders_last_180', 'sales_last_90', 'sales_last_180',
        'sales_prev_90', 'sales_growth', 'orders_growth',
        'avg_payment_value', 'n_reviews_last_90',
        'avg_delivery_days', 'delivered_ratio',
        'days_since_first_review', 'active_days_last_90',
        'price_trend', 'n_buyers', 'avg_items_per_order'
    ]
    for f in feature_names:
        features[f] = 0.0

    # Только позиции, купленные до seed_time (ts = момент покупки)
    mask = (order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_list)) & (order_items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask].copy()

    if not items.empty:
        # ---- Базовые агрегаты ----
        agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            n_items=('price', 'size'),
            total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            std_freight=('freight_value', 'std'),
            n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            n_buyers=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            first_purchase=('ts', 'min'),
            last_purchase=('ts', 'max')
        )
        agg['avg_items_per_order'] = agg['n_items'] / agg['n_orders'].replace(0, np.nan)
        agg['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - agg['last_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['lifetime_days'] = (agg['last_purchase'] - agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
        agg['has_sales'] = 1

        base_cols = [
            'n_orders', 'n_items', 'total_sales', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
            'avg_freight', 'std_freight', 'n_sellers', 'days_since_first',
            'days_since_last', 'lifetime_days', 'has_sales',
            'n_buyers', 'avg_items_per_order'
        ]
        for col in base_cols:
            features.loc[agg.index, col] = agg[col].values

        # ---- Динамика продаж по периодам ----
        def period_stats(items_df, days_back_lo, days_back_hi):
            lo = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days_back_hi)
            hi = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days_back_lo)
            sub = items_df[(items_df['ts'] > lo) & (items_df['ts'] <= hi)]
            g = sub.groupby('product_id').agg(
                n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
                sales=('price', 'sum'),
                n_items=('price', 'size'),
                first_ts=('ts', 'min'),
                last_ts=('ts', 'max')
            )
            return g

        cur90 = period_stats(items, 0, 90)
        prev90 = period_stats(items, 90, 180)
        cur180 = period_stats(items, 0, 180)

        for period in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
            g = period_stats(items, 0, period)
            if not g.empty:
                features.loc[g.index, f'n_orders_last_{period}'] = g['n_orders'].values

        if not cur90.empty:
            features.loc[cur90.index, 'sales_last_90'] = cur90['sales'].values
            # активные дни внутри последних 90 дней
            act = cur90.groupby('product_id').apply(
                lambda x: x['last_ts'].normalize().sub(x['first_ts'].normalize()).dt.days.clip(upper=90) + 1
            )
            features.loc[act.index, 'active_days_last_90'] = act.values
        if not cur180.empty:
            features.loc[cur180.index, 'sales_last_180'] = cur180['sales'].values
        if not prev90.empty:
            features.loc[prev90.index, 'sales_prev_90'] = prev90['sales'].values

        # рост: сравнение последних 90 дней с предыдущими 90
        both = features.loc[features['sales_prev_90'] > 0, ['sales_last_90', 'sales_prev_90']]
        if not both.empty:
            features.loc[both.index, 'sales_growth'] = (
                both['sales_last_90'] / both['sales_prev_90'].replace(0, np.nan)
            ).fillna(0.0)
        both_o = features.loc[features['n_orders_last_180'] > 0, ['n_orders_last_90', 'n_orders_last_180']]
        if not both_o.empty:
            features.loc[both_o.index, 'orders_growth'] = (
                both_o['n_orders_last_90'] * 2.0 / both_o['n_orders_last_180'].replace(0, np.nan)
            ).fillna(0.0)

        # тренд цены: средняя цена последних 90 дней минус средняя до этого
        old = items[items['ts'] <= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
        if not old.empty and not cur90.empty:
            old_price = old.groupby('product_id')['price'].mean()
            cur_price = cur90['n_items']  # placeholder to align index
            cur_price_mean = items[(items['ts'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90))] \
                .groupby('product_id')['price'].mean()
            common = cur_price_mean.index.intersection(old_price.index)
            if len(common) > 0:
                features.loc[common, 'price_trend'] = (
                    cur_price_mean.loc[common] - old_price.loc[common]
                ).values

        # ---- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к seed_time ----
        rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time].copy()
        uniq_orders = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
        rev_merged = uniq_orders.merge(
            rev[['order_id', 'review_score', 'review_creation_date']],
            on='order_id', how='inner'
        )
        if not rev_merged.empty:
            rev_agg = rev_merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
                avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
                std_review_score=('review_score', 'std'),
                n_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
                first_review=('review_creation_date', 'min')
            )
            rev_agg['days_since_first_review'] = (
                seed_time - rev_agg['first_review']
            ).dt.days
            rev_last90 = rev_merged[
                rev_merged['review_creation_date'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
            ].groupby('product_id')['review_score'].count()
            for col in ['avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'n_reviews',
                        'days_since_first_review']:
                features.loc[rev_agg.index, col] = rev_agg[col].values
            features.loc[rev_last90.index, 'n_reviews_last_90'] = rev_last90.values

        # ---- Доставка и платежи: только по заказам, существующим к seed_time ----
        order_ids = items['order_id'].unique()
        ord_info = orders[orders['order_id'].isin(order_ids)][
            ['order_id', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
             'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_status']
        ].copy()
        # доставка известна только если дата доставки уже проставлена и не в будущем
        ord_info['delivered_known'] = (
            ord_info['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()
        ) & (ord_info['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
        ord_info['delivery_days'] = (
            ord_info['order_delivered_customer_date'] - ord_info['order_purchase_timestamp']
        ).dt.days
        ord_info.loc[~ord_info['delivered_known'], 'delivery_days'] = np.nan

        prod_orders = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(
            ord_info[['order_id', 'delivery_days', 'delivered_known']],
            on='order_id', how='left'
        )
        del_agg = prod_orders.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
            delivered_ratio=('delivered_known', 'mean')
        )
        for col in ['avg_delivery_days', 'delivered_ratio']:
            features.loc[del_agg.index, col] = del_agg[col].values

        pay = payments[payments['order_id'].isin(order_ids) & (payments['ts'] <= seed_time)]
        if not pay.empty:
            pay_agg = pay.groupby('order_id')['payment_value'].sum()
            po = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
            po['pay'] = po['order_id'].map(pay_agg)
            pay_by_prod = po.groupby('product_id')['pay'].mean()
            features.loc[pay_by_prod.index, 'avg_payment_value'] = pay_by_prod.values

    features = features.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    features = features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_list)
    features = features.fillna(0.0)

    return features
